name: starflask_generate_speech
description: Create a Starflask text-to-speech (audio) generation job. Returns a job id immediately — poll with starflask_get_job until status is 'completed', then read the audio URL from the result. Provide the `text` to speak; optionally a `voice` id and a `model_key` (default chatterbox-tts). The job type is sent as "audio" for you. Use starflask_list_models to see available audio models and supported voices.

text.description: The text to synthesize into speech.

voice.description: Optional voice id (see starflask_list_models for the chosen model's supported voices).

model_key.description: Optional audio model key. Defaults to chatterbox-tts.
